statement: A knight is placed on each square of the first column of a \(2017 \times 2017\) board. A move: choose two knights and move each one knight-step away. Find all \(k\) with \(1 \leq k \leq 2017\) such that after finitely many moves, each square of the \(k\)-th column contains exactly one knight.

A set of \(n\) positive integers is balanced if for each \(k\) with \(1 \leq k \leq n\), the average of any \(k\) elements is an integer. Find the maximum possible sum of elements of a balanced set with all elements at most 2017.

Let \(ABC\) be an acute triangle with orthocenter \(H\). The circle through \(B, H, C\) meets lines \(AB\) and \(AC\) at \(D\) and \(E\); segment \(DE\) meets \(HB\) and \(HC\) at \(P\) and \(Q\). Points \(X \neq A\) on line \(AP\) and \(Y \neq A\) on line \(AQ\) satisfy: \(X, H, A, B\) concyclic and \(Y, H, A, C\) concyclic. Show \(XY \parallel BC\).
A subset \(B\) of \(\{1, 2, \ldots, 2017\}\) has property T if any three elements of \(B\) are the sides of a nondegenerate triangle. Find the maximum number of elements in a set with property T.

On circle \(\Gamma\), points \(A, B, N, C, D, M\) are chosen clockwise with \(N\) the midpoint of clockwise arc \(BC\) and \(M\) the midpoint of clockwise arc \(AD\). Let \(P = AC \cap BD\) and \(Q\) on line \(MB\) with \(PQ \perp MN\). Point \(R\) on segment \(MC\) satisfies \(QB = RC\). Prove the midpoint of \(QR\) lies on \(AC\).

Two players \(A\) and \(B\) alternate (\(A\) first). \(m\) ballot boxes are in a line. Each turn: \(A\) places a ballot in each of two chosen boxes; \(B\) removes all ballots from one box. \(A\) wins if some box contains \(n\) ballots after \(B\)'s turn. For each \(n\), find the minimum \(m\) for \(A\) to guarantee a win.
